contracts.codex: Existing ChatGPT login and configured model via ephemeral app-server; no shell, files, web, MCP tools or paid fallback in question runner.

contracts.storage: One additive document_assistant_turns table; original/historical HWPX and existing frozen workflows preserved.
contracts.navigation: Unsent drafts retained, pending turn blocks destructive navigation, permission loss releases active hold while preserving drafts.
contracts.display: Only actual running/completed status; no simulated token streaming. Preview collapses on sending; latest answer scrolls within conversation panel above composer.
